title: Add the 26 SIM providers
preconditions: make seed-demo (or an empty DB with an admin); signed in
steps: Administration → Settings → SIM providers: add each provider of settings_sim_providers.csv with its e-mail and default plan; choose Telia LT as the default; Non-return Value 30.00 €. Or PUT settings_sim_providers.request.json to /api/v1/settings/sim-providers
expected: Settings lists 26 providers in order, Telia LT chosen first, 30.00 €

title: Provider e-mails go nowhere real
steps: Open a provider's e-mail on Settings
expected: Every address is …@example.com, so a test e-mail never reaches an operator

title: Check the Lithuania SIM list without writing
preconditions: SIM-001 done; make seed-demo (for the holders)
steps: make import-sims FILE=docs/test-packs/sim-cards-baltics-poland/import/sim-import-lt.csv
expected: Each card is listed with its status and holder; nothing is written; no problems

title: Import all four countries
steps: make import-sims FILE=…/import/sim-import-all.csv COMMIT=yes
expected: 91 SIM cards added in one go; held ones given to their employee with no form; Available and Not Activated in the Office

title: Semicolons, a byte order mark and columns in another order
steps: make import-sims FILE=…/import/sim-import-all-semicolon-bom.csv
expected: Read the same as the comma file: same cards, no problems

title: Running the import twice imports nothing
steps: Run SIM-007's command again
expected: Refused: every SIM No. is already registered; nothing written

title: Every problem is listed, nothing written
steps: make import-sims FILE=…/import/sim-import-errors.csv
expected: Nothing is written. First pass: lines 2-4 named (Available with a holder, unknown employee, unknown status). Delete them and run again: the unknown provider is only noted, line 6 refused (not a phone number), and after SIM-007 line 5 (SIM No. already registered)

title: Tabs count and filter by status
steps: Company Assets → SIM Cards; open each tab
expected: Counts match sim_cards.csv's statuses (Available counts as Active)

title: Phone numbers of four countries
steps: Open an LV, an EE and a PL card
expected: Phone No. shown as written (+371 …, +372 …, +48 …)

title: Find a card by number in ⌘K
steps: ⌘K, type the last 6 digits of a SIM No.
expected: The card is found and opens beside the register

title: Add SIM by hand for each country
steps: Add SIM with a SIM No. of block 3 (any provider) from add_sim_manual.csv
expected: Added Not Activated in the Office, provider's default plan and the 30.00 € value filled in

title: A prepaid card
steps: Add SIM, provider Labas (or any prepaid brand)
expected: The plan is the brand's prepaid plan from Settings

title: Give SIM against a printed form
preconditions: an Active card in the Office
steps: Give SIM to Ona Kazlauskienė; print the form; Upload Signed Form (any PDF)
expected: Given; form printed with provider, plan, phone and value; signed copy listed

title: Print Form for an imported held card
preconditions: SIM-007 done; Edit the card's Non-return Value first
steps: Open a held card from the import → ⋯ → Print Form
expected: Without a value it says so; with one it prints, dated 2026-08-03; asset.form_printed recorded

title: Return and Mark as Not Returned
steps: Return one; Mark the other as Not Returned with a reason
expected: The first is back in the Office; the second shows Not Returned; neither status changed

title: Change Status never moves the card
steps: Change Status → Blocked
expected: Blocked, still with its holder

title: Prepare Activation Email
preconditions: a Not Activated card; Mail Templates set
steps: Open the card → Prepare Activation Email
expected: To is the provider's example.com address, the card's numbers filled in; Send Email only opens your mail app

title: Prepare Blocking Email
steps: Prepare Blocking Email
expected: As above, the blocking template

title: Scan the valid printed cards
preconditions: SIM-001 done; scan_cards.html printed or on a second screen
steps: Open /apps/sim-scan/; For every SIM: provider; photograph front and back of SC-001…SC-052 (by provider)
expected: Each SIM No. read from the Code 128 barcode, never the EAN-13; PIN and PUK read; Add adds them all

title: The review list marks every problem
steps: Scan SC-053…SC-060
expected: Check digit, duplicate, …5F, PIN, PUK and registered cards are marked; Add refuses until fixed

title: Show PIN and PUK
preconditions: cards added by SIM-022; a recent sign-in
steps: Show PIN and PUK; find a card by number
expected: Asks for your password if the sign-in is not recent; shows the codes from scan_cards.csv; recorded as asset.sim_codes_shown

title: An employee sees no SIM cards
steps: Sign in as the employee; open /assets/sim-cards
expected: Company Assets is not offered; the API answers 403

title: Every change is in the Changes
steps: Open a card → Changes; Administration → Audit log, filter asset.*
expected: asset.registered, asset.given, asset.returned, asset.status_changed … with who and when
